cause: Frames.base provides App=struct() on ACK, so field existence alone does not establish SourceId/Id. observe dereferenced ACK application identity and aborted each real MAC transmit callback.
change: Export application identity only for DATA kind; ACK and NONE retain zero defaults. Keep strict DATA accesses so malformed DATA is not silently treated as ACK.
regression: Existing actual aggregate test verifies real acknowledgment constructor Kind=ACK and fieldless scalar App, all six boundaries, DATA app source 5/id 3, and zero ACK identities across aggregate_tx, ack_tx and feedback_ingress. The gateway identity and ACK-drain tests now assert all six expected boundary cases before iterating, preventing vacuous passes when the fixture aborts before producing a boundary.
audit: selectedMembers reads b.App only after short-circuit strcmp(b.Kind,DATA).
deliver(app,peer) receives a valid NWK Delivered application; synthetic observed delivery frame explicitly has Kind DATA and App app.
prime and DATA ingress use Frames.data, which validates scalar application and required SourceId/Id fields.
ACK source/gateway TX and feedback ingress use Frames.acknowledgment, whose App remains fieldless.
settled observes struct() and retains NONE kind and zero identifiers.
Sequence, bitmaps, source/destination and MAC queue/counter fields follow Frames.base and existing MAC schema.
